title: Expose PDF version compatibility (1.0-2.0) as a pdfxi CLI command
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-cli passes; pdfxi compat reports the header/effective version, warnings, and every version-dependent feature gate on real files across 1.0-2.0; a 1.4 file lists the 1.5+ constructs as unsupported, a 2.0 file supports all of them, a catalog /Version override is reported, and --json emits stable names. STD-001 moves to verified with that command as its reachable path.
notes: STD-001 was library-only: pdfxi-core::compatibility already parses the header, honours a catalog /Version override, gates the twelve PdfFeature constructs and scans for their tokens, but no user could reach it. Add `pdfxi compat <FILE> [--json] [--strict]` so the capability runs on real document bytes from the CLI. --strict exits 3 when the effective version cannot use a construct that is present in the file, for scripts.
